jobs.occupation: Want to shape how a global platform with 4 million users builds with AI? Spond is hiring Backend Engineer (apply without a CV or cover letter)
jobs.description:
Want to shape how a global platform with over 4 million monthly active users builds with AI? We are looking for someone to help us build and scale our AI agent platform.

Spond is a product-driven tech company that simplifies life for sports teams, clubs, and volunteers. By streamlining administration, payments and communication, our platform takes the heavy lifting out of grassroots sports.

Today we support over 4 million monthly active users globally and are driving strong traction in markets such as the UK, France, Norway, and Germany. We consistently rank at the top of the App Store's sports category and are highly valued by our community, with a Net Promoter Score of 76, outperforming services like Netflix, Airbnb and Uber.

The position

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join the AI & Platform Engineering team, to build and maintain the platform behind our AI agents. You'll build internal products for engineers such as tooling, APIs, SDKs, integrations, and developer workflows. You'll take them from design through to production and scaling, improving developer experience and driving real adoption across Spond's engineering teams.

This role sits in our Platform Engineering & AI team, which owns Spond's infrastructure and developer platform. You don't need to be an infrastructure expert for this role. We care most about strong software engineering fundamentals and genuine motivation to build in the AI space and to work in a platform team. We collaborate closely inside the team, so you'll naturally pick up our platform stack (Kubernetes on AWS, IaC, CI/CD) and pitch in where it helps, while your main focus stays on the AI agent platform and related tooling.

What you'll be working on:

• 

Building and maintaining the Go services, libraries, and tooling that let engineers across the company build with AI safely and consistently.

• 

Developing agent-based tooling and workflows that drive AI adoption internally, for example cloud agents in developer workflows and automated root cause analysis.

• 

Designing robust APIs and integrations between our agent platform, internal/external services, and model providers.

• 

Ensuring the software you ship is observable, reliable, and well-tested, and taking it end-to-end from design to operation.

• 

Contributing to the broader platform where it helps the team.

• 

Collaborating with engineering teams to understand their needs, remove friction, and pave golden paths for how AI is used at Spond.

• 

Advocating for good practice through clear documentation and knowledge sharing, so adoption sticks.

What can we offer?

• 

A passionate and dedicated team with a high level of professional expertise.

• 

The opportunity to work on a product used by millions of people.

• 

Flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home.

• 

Access to a company cabin for you and your family.

• 

Competitive salary, professional development budget, strong insurance coverage, pension plan, and occupational health services.

• 

Newly renovated offices with a cafeteria, gym, and pleasant social areas.

What we look for:

• 

Backend expertise; at least 3 years of development experience is a useful reference, but we care more about how you've grown and how clearly you think than exact tenure.

• 

Comfortable in at least one backend language and keen to work in Go, which we use for platform and agent tooling.

• 

A solid grasp of how modern software is built and shipped: testing, code review, CI/CD, and the wider development lifecycle. This is what you'll encode into agents and tooling.

• 

A strong appetite to build in the AI and agent space. Experience with AI-powered tooling or building agents is a plus, but motivation and curiosity matter most.

• 

Familiarity with AI guardrails and secure, responsible use of AI is a strong plus.

• 

Keen to work in a platform team and upskill on our stack: Kubernetes, AWS, and infrastructure as code

• 

Owns problems end-to-end and pushes them over the line without close oversight.

• 

Clear communicator who enjoys documentation, advocacy, and knowledge sharing.

• 

Fluency in English is essential (understanding Norwegian is a plus but not mandatory).

Apply without CV or cover letter!

jobs.occupation: Want to take ownership of the technology behind smarter business spending?
jobs.description:
At Done Spend, you’ll build the features and integrations that help businesses manage corporate cards, capture expenses and control spending in real time.

As our Full Stack Engineer, you’ll take ownership of core platform components, contribute to architectural decisions and follow your work from initial idea through to deployment. Working closely with our Technical Lead and Product team, you’ll help shape how features are built and how the platform develops.

For this role, we welcome candidates who would like to work from either our Oslo, Stockholm or Skövde office.

What you’ll work on

Your work will span frontend development, backend services and integrations. Alongside building new features, you’ll improve the reliability, security and performance of the platform businesses use to manage their spending.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Building and maintaining secure, scalable frontend and backend components.
• Developing API integrations, authentication flows, webhooks and data synchronisation processes.
• Contributing to technical design and assessing the feasibility of new features with Product.
• Writing unit and integration tests, investigating bugs and improving performance and monitoring.
• Maintaining clear technical documentation and identifying opportunities to improve automation and reliability.
You’ll also contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives, helping the team improve how it delivers software.
What you’ll bring
You have 2 to 4 years of experience building production applications and can work across both frontend and backend development.

We’re looking for:

• Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, with experience writing production code across the stack.
• Experience in fintech, particularly payments or spend management, is a strong advantage. 
• Experience with React and modern single-page application frameworks.
• Experience with NestJS or a comparable structured backend framework, such as .NET.
• Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or working with event-driven systems.
• Experience with PostgreSQL, solid SQL fundamentals and confidence working with raw SQL, query builders and ORMs.
• An understanding of maintainable code, separation of concerns and scalable system design.
• Strong spoken English skills are required
You’re comfortable working in an Agile team and discussing technical decisions with colleagues across engineering and product . You consider how your code will be tested, maintained and operated after deployment, and take responsibility for resolving issues.

React Native experience is required.
Why join Done Spend?
• Own meaningful parts of the platform. Take responsibility for core components, from feature development to architectural decisions.
• Influence technical direction. Work closely with the Technical Lead, Product team and leadership as the platform grows.
• Build across the stack. Work on user-facing features, backend services and the integrations that connect them.
• See your work in use. Build and improve systems that support real business spending and transactions.
• Choose between Oslo, Stockholm or Skövde. We welcome candidates who would like to work from either office.About Done Spend
Done Spend is part of the Done.ai group and is building an expense management platform for growing companies. By combining smart corporate cards, automated expense capture and real-time financial controls, we help businesses manage how they spend, track and control their money.

As the platform grows, reliable systems and thoughtful engineering are central to the experience we deliver.

Interested in helping shape the next phase of Done Spend? We’d like to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: PhD candidate in Artistic Research – Digital Environments
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
The Trondheim Academy of Fine Art (KIT), Faculty of Architecture and Design, invites applications for a fixed-term, three-year PhD position in Artistic Research. The PhD will be part of the focus area Digital Environments within Artistic Research.

This PhD position explores, through artistic and practice-based research, the role and societal impact of AI and other emerging technologies, including how digital technologies reshape the relationships between knowledge production, creative practice, accountability, and social and ecological transformation.

The position contributes to artistic research, critical inquiry, and experimentation across AI, sensing, data analysis and visualisation, and investigative practices, addressing key societal challenges at the intersection of art, architecture, design, media, and technology. Embedded in KIT’s strategic focus on the role of art in addressing societal change, the position is connected to ongoing research initiatives, digital infrastructure, and externally funded projects. It will strengthen KIT’s research profile in digitalisation and societal transformation while supporting future national and international research collaborations and funding opportunities. 

As a PhD Candidate, you will work towards a doctorate while gaining valuable research experience and qualifications for a career in higher education, research, and related sectors.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.
Duties of the position
You will develop an independent artistic and practice-based research project within the overall scope of the position. The project should engage with at least one of the first two areas below and at least one of the last two, without being limited to them:

1. Investigative practices, including open-source, scientific, data-driven and participatory approaches.2. Sensing, analysis, modelling, visualisation and communication of disparate data and digital environments, through approaches including critical spatial practice and data science.3. Technology in the public interest, including accountability and community-centred approaches to emerging technologies.4. The role of artistic research in the development and application of emerging technologies, including new forms of knowledge production and collaboration between artistic, scientific and technological research. 

The successful candidate will contribute to and make use of the research infrastructure of the Artistic Research Sensing and Visualisation Lab (ARSV-Lab), which develops technological resources and knowledge in multi-perspective sensing and data visualisation.You will have opportunities to participate in relevant existing externally funded research projects and networks, including the ERC project Sensing Ecocide and the COST Action Artistic Intelligence, and to contribute to the wider research environment and research culture of the department.You will participate in the Norwegian Artistic Research School (NARS) as part of their obligatory training component, alongside other candidates in Norwegian PhD programmes in Artistic Research.- Complete doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate- Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above- Academic publications and popular science dissemination- Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions- Other career-promoting work

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme for Artistic Research PHKUNST, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information. 
• You must have a relevant Master's degree in art, architecture, design or a closely related field, or equivalent qualifications. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
• Demonstrated experience or interest in artistic, practice-based or interdisciplinary approaches to digital technologies, and digital environments.
• Demonstrated ability to pursue independent, mentored research and work collaboratively with interdisciplinary research team.
• Track record in artistic research and/or relevant professional practice at an international level.
• Strong command of both written and spoken English is a prerequisite. 
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Personal characteristics
• Excellent communications and teamwork skills 
• Work independently 
• Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them 
• Present and discuss your research with other professionals 
• Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback 
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer
Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

• An exciting job with an important mission in society
• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
• Working capital that can be used to implement the project
• Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
• Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Artistic research within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application
The attachments must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

• Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
• A cover letter 
• A preliminary PhD project proposal (3 – 5 pages) 
• CV, certificates and diplomas 
• A portfolio or other relevant documentation 
• Names and contact information of three relevant referees
Please do not include full publications or other scientific/artistic works as separate attachments.

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).
General information
A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Nabil Ahmed, telephone: +47 403 14 215, email nabil.ahmed@ntnu.no. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR advisor Natalia Swahn, e-mail: Natalia.swahn@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 31.12.2026

jobs.occupation: Postdoktor innen etterutdanning for lærere
jobs.description:
Om stillingen 
Institutt for lærerutdanning og skoleforskning har ledig stilling som postdoktor for en periode på 3 år innen etterutdanning for lærere.Stillingen er knyttet til prosjektet Observation Tools to support Excellence and Responsiveness in teaching (OTER), finansiert av Norges forskningsråd (NFR).Prosjektet tar utgangspunkt i et DeKomp prosjekt (PLATO DeKomp) som gjennomføres som et samarbeid mellom Institutt for lærerutdanning og skoleforskning (ILS) ved Universitetet i Oslo og Utdanningsetaten i Oslo kommune. Syv skoler er med på et utviklingsprosjekt der de får undervisning og øvelse i spesifikke undervisningspraksiser som vi vet er viktige for elevers læring. OTER-prosjektet undersøker hvordan to ulike verktøy, i kombinasjon med videobasert veiledning, kan bidra til lærernes undervisningskvalitet og inkluderende undervisning. Prosjektet anvender observasjonsverktøyet Protocol for Language Art Teaching Observation (PLATO) som er testet ut og validert for bruk i norske klasserom, kombinert med et nyutviklet verktøy som handler om hvordan lærere kan inkludere alle elevene og tilpasse til ulike elevers behov. I prosjektet skal lærere filme sin egen undervisning og få videobasert veiledning i grupper på egen skole. Veiledningen skal gjennomføres av ressurslærere som har fått opplæring i verktøyene som er utviklet i prosjektet (PLATO og inkluderingsverktøyene). Målet er å teste ut hvordan kompetanse kan overføres fra forskere på universitetet til ledere og lærere på skolenivå (prosjektskissen kan etterspøres for mer informasjon).OTER-prosjektet fokuserer både på lærerutdanningen og etterutdanning for lærere. Denne utlysningen er knyttet til arbeidspakken som handler om etterutdanning for lærere.

Et postdoktor-prosjekt knyttet til OTER kan for eksempel fokusere på:•    læreres praksisbaserte muligheter til å lære, inkludert bruk av video•    bruk av verktøy (PLATO protokollen og inkluderingsverktøyene) i profesjonsutvikling for lærere•    veiledning av lærere i profesjonsfellesskap•    modeller for kompetanseutvikling i skolen 

Prosjekts samarbeidspartnere er:•    Høgskolen i Østfold •    Universitetet i Innlandet •    Dysleksi  Norge •    Internasjonale partnere 
Mer om stillingen 
Ansettelsen gjelder for en periode på 3 år med 10 % annet karrierefremmende arbeid, som normalt består av undervisning og tilsvarende arbeid.Hovedformålet med en postdoktorstilling er at den ansatte skal opparbeide seg en forskerprofil og kompetanse som gjør vedkommende kvalifisert for å søke stilling som førsteamanuensis innen sitt fagområde. Stillingen kan i tillegg gi annen kompetanse med relevans for postdoktorens videre karriere.Dersom postdoktoren ikke allerede har utdanningsfaglig kompetanse som innfrir kravene til en stilling som førsteamanuensis, skal UiO tilrettelegge for at postdoktoren opparbeider seg slik kompetanse i løpet av ansettelsesperioden.Det skal utarbeides en karriereplan for postdoktoren, som spesifiserer den kompetansen som postdoktoren skal opparbeide seg. UiO har ansvar for at karriereplanen følges opp og at postdoktoren har tilgang til karriereveiledning gjennom postdoktorløpet.
Kvalifikasjonskrav 
• Det kreves doktorgrad (PhD) innenfor fagdidaktikk, pedagogikk, lærerutdanning, utdanningsledelse, eller veilederutdanning. For søkere som ikke har disputert er det en forutsetning at doktorgradsarbeidet er levert til vurdering før søknadsfristens utløp. Det er videre en forutsetning for tiltredelse i postdoktorstillingen at disputasen er godkjent
• God fremstillingsevne skriftlig og muntlig på engelsk og norsk (eller et annet skandinavisk språk)
I tillegg vil det være en fordel med følgende kvalifikasjoner: 

• Erfaring med bruk av Protocol for Language Art Teaching Observation (PLATO) observasjonsverktøy eller tilsvarende 
• Erfaring med analyse av videodata
• Erfaring med etter- og videreutdanning for lærerePersonlige egenskaper 
• Evne til kreativ tenkning 
• Evne til å arbeide selvstendig 
• Evne til å håndtere utfordringer
• Kvalitetsbevisst  Vi trenger ulike perspektiver i vårt arbeid 
UiO er et åpent og internasjonalt breddeuniversitet, og vil være en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsplass og studiested. Les mer om UiOs arbeid for likestilling, inkludering og mangfold på uio.no.

Vi løser vårt samfunnsoppdrag best når vi tar i bruk våre ulike erfaringer, bakgrunner og perspektiver. Vi vil gjerne ha flere gode kolleger - kanskje den neste er deg?Vi vil tilrettelegge dersom du har behov for det. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være endring av arbeidstid, tilpasning av arbeidsoppgaver, digital, teknisk, eller fysisk tilrettelegging eller andre praktiske tilpasninger.
 
Har du innvandrerbakgrunn, funksjonsnedsettelse eller hull i CV-en, oppfordrer vi deg til å krysse av for dette i jobbsøkerportalen. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert søker fra hver gruppe til intervju. Med funksjonsnedsettelse menes her en søker som oppgir å ha en funksjonsnedsettelse som vil medføre tilrettelegging på arbeidsplassen eller i arbeidsforholdet. Les mer om kravene på Arbeidsgiverportalen.Avkrysningene i jobbsøkerportalen blir brukt til anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter. Mer informasjon om likestillingstiltak ved UiO finner du her.Vi håper at du søker på stillingen hos oss.
Vi tilbyr 
• Lønn fra kr 595 000 til kr 670 000 avhengig av kompetanse og erfaring, i stilling som postdoktor (stillingskode 1352). Fra lønnen trekkes 2 prosent i lovfestet innskudd til Statens Pensjonskasse
• Et hyggelig og stimulerende arbeidsmiljø
• Gode velferdsordninger 
• Medlemskap i Statens Pensjonskasse, som er en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger med gunstige boliglån og gode forsikringsordningerSøknaden skal inneholde 
• Søknadsbrev 
• Prosjektbeskrivelse. Prosjektbeskrivelsen må spesifisere hvordan prosjektet kobler seg til OTER-prosjektet, og inkludere en fremdriftsplan (maks 10 sider). Kvaliteten på prosjektbeskrivelsen er avgjørende for komiteens vurdering 
• CV (fullstendig oversikt over utdanning, stillinger, pedagogisk erfaring, administrativ erfaring, praksis og faglig arbeid)
• Kopi av PhD-diplom eller dokumentasjon på innlevert avhandling. Søkere som ikke har disputert på søknadstidspunkt må vedlegge en bekreftelse fra veileder der det utheves tydelig når doktorgrad forventes oppnådd 
• Kopier av vitnemål og attester 
• Komplett publikasjonsliste
• Opptil tre akademiske arbeider som det skal tas hensyn til ved bedømmelsen
• Referanseliste (2-3 referanser; navn, tittel, e-post og telefon, samt beskrivelse av relasjon til søker)
• Søknaden kan skrives på engelsk eller et skandinavisk språk 
Søknad med vedlegg må sendes inn via vårt elektroniske rekrutteringssystem Jobbnorge. Ved utdanning utenfor Skandinavia ber vi om en forklaring på karaktersystemet. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at all dokumentasjon må være på engelsk (eller et skandinavisk språk).

Ufullstendige søknader vil ikke bli behandlet.

Ved vurdering av søkerne vil det bli lagt spesiell vekt på de dokumenterte akademiske kvalifikasjonene, prosjektbeskrivelsen (når dette kreves i utlysningen), samt kvaliteten på prosjektet, kandidatens motivasjon og personlige egnethet. Det skal som hovedregel benyttes intervju i ansettelsesprosessen.

Det forutsettes at den som tilsettes vil kunne gjennomføre prosjektet i løpet av tilsettingsperioden.

Du må begrunne hvorfor du ønsker unntak fra offentliggjøring og vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det vil du høre fra oss.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Oslo er Norges eldste og høyest rangerte forsknings- og utdanningsinstitusjon med 27 400 studenter og 6 900 ansatte. Faglig bredde og internasjonalt anerkjente forskningsmiljøer gjør UiO til en viktig samfunnsaktør.

Institutt for lærerutdanning og skoleforskning (ILS) er ett av tre institutter ved Det utdanningsvitenskapelige fakultet. ILS er Norges ledende miljø innen fagdidaktikk, utdanningsledelse og praksisrelevant skoleforskning.

Ved instituttet ligger også EKVA (Enhet for Kvantitative Utdanningsanalyser), fem fakultære forskergrupper (COSER, CLEG, LEA, SISCO og TEPEC) og FIKS (forskning, innovasjon og kompetanseutvikling i skolen). Instituttet har ca. 300 studenter i praktisk-pedagogisk utdanning og forvalter UiOs femårige lektorprogram som tar opp ca. 300 studenter hvert år. Ca. 200 studenter følger instituttets masterprogram i utdanningsledelse. ILS har ca. 44 administrative og 90 vitenskapelige ansatte.
